Partners Group has strengthened its direct infrastructure team in Europe with the senior hires of Philip Butcher, Timm Degenhardt and Sarah Johnson.

Butcher joins as a managing director, based in London. He will be responsible for originating and executing new direct investments, with a focus on digital and transport infrastructure in Europe. Butcher joins from Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments), where he spent 15 years, rising to managing director in the Infrastructure Group and most recently leading the group’s global data center strategy. During his career, Butcher has worked on a number of high-profile transactions across the data center, transport and energy sectors.
